## Activity

During November 2020, West Gate Eye Clinic completed 312 captures as part of routine site activity. The recorded volume provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes for the month. Activity should continue to be monitored through the usual operational arrangements, with any recurring issues recorded for follow-up.

## Image quality

A total of 12 captures were assessed as ungradable, representing an ungradable rate of 3.8. This result should be reviewed alongside the operational experience at the site to identify any recurring causes of poor image quality. The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk so they can be tracked and addressed.

## Grading

Grading identified 66 referable results during the reporting period. The median lag between image capture and completion of grading was 1. This measure should continue to be monitored with referable outcomes, as timely grading supports appropriate onward action. The activity, image quality, and grading figures should be retained for routine service review.
